simple.meaning: שָׁעַע (shâʻaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “(in a good acceptation) to look upon (with complacency), i.e. fondle , please or amuse (self); (in a bad one) to look about (in dismay), i.e. stare.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 9 times across Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at Psalms 94:19. Its contexts include commandment.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁעַע (H8173).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
